## Type of change

- [ ] Content correction or clarification

## Checklist

- [ ] `pytest` and `mkdocs build --strict` pass locally
- [ ] Plain English, following the GOV.UK style guide
- [ ] No secrets, internal hostnames, personal data or sensitive security detail
- [ ] Guardrail or NFR ids are new or unchanged, never reused
- [ ] Significant change added to `docs/about/changelog.md`
